# Blockers: random effects meta-analysis of clinical trials
# Generated from JuliaBUGS.BUGSExamples.VOLUME_1.blockers
using JuliaBUGS

model_def = JuliaBUGS.@bugs("""
model {
    for( i in 1 : Num ) {
        rc[i] ~ dbin(pc[i], nc[i])
        rt[i] ~ dbin(pt[i], nt[i])
        logit(pc[i]) <- mu[i]
        logit(pt[i]) <- mu[i] + delta[i]
        mu[i] ~ dnorm(0.0,1.0E-5)
        delta[i] ~ dnorm(d, tau)
    }
    d ~ dnorm(0.0,1.0E-6)
    tau ~ dgamma(0.001,0.001)
    delta.new ~ dnorm(d, tau)
    sigma <- 1 / sqrt(tau)
}
""", false)

build_model(data, inits = (;)) = JuliaBUGS.compile(model_def, data, inits)
